result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: Verse 26:10 directly gives Uzziah’s abundant livestock as the reason for both building the desert towers and digging the cisterns. The following statement about loving the soil explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers, not why he built the towers and cisterns. The edit preserves the source question’s intended focus while correcting the causal answer.
